current_detections.name: Liquidity Sweep
current_detections.evidence: Price spiked above the prior range high (~562) to approximately 585+ on extreme volume, then reversed sharply downward, consistent with a stop-hunt liquidity sweep above the range.

current_detections.name: Evening Star
current_detections.evidence: At the spike high, a large bullish candle was followed by a small-bodied candle and then a strong bearish candle, forming a classic evening star reversal at the top.

current_detections.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
current_detections.evidence: The bullish breakout to ~585 failed; price is reversing down and approaching the pre-spike swing low (~557), suggesting a shift from bullish to bearish character.
current_detections.missing_conditions: Confirmed close below the swing low (~557) to validate bearish CHoCH.

tracked_patterns.name: Liquidity Sweep
tracked_patterns.evidence: Price spiked below 553 around 08:00, sweeping liquidity, then reversed strongly with a large green candle rallying toward 560.

tracked_patterns.name: Double Top
tracked_patterns.evidence: Two distinct swing highs visible near the 560-561 zone. Price is currently at 555.99 testing the neckline support area around 555-556 after declining from the second top.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Completed candle close below neckline support (~555) to confirm breakdown and activate the reversal.

tracked_patterns.name: Symmetrical Triangle
tracked_patterns.evidence: Recent price action showing compression with lower highs and higher lows forming converging boundaries between approximately 554 and 558.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Clear breakout above resistance (~558) or below support (~554) with a completed candle close to confirm direction.

tracked_patterns.name: Bullish Flag
tracked_patterns.evidence: Sharp upward impulse from approximately 552 to 560 followed by sideways consolidation near 556-558
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Breakout above consolidation resistance, defined flag channel boundaries, volume confirmation on breakout

tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
tracked_patterns.evidence: The bullish breakout to ~585 failed; price is reversing down and approaching the pre-spike swing low (~557), suggesting a shift from bullish to bearish character.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Confirmed close below the swing low (~557) to validate bearish CHoCH.

tracked_patterns.name: Bearish Flag
tracked_patterns.evidence: Sharp downward impulse from approximately 560 to 555 followed by tight sideways consolidation near current price.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Breakout below flag support around 554 to confirm continuation.

tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character
tracked_patterns.evidence: Prior bullish structure weakened after failure at 562 high and decline toward previous swing low area.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Candle close below swing low to confirm structural shift from bullish to bearish.

tracked_patterns.name: Change of Character (Bearish)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Market structure shifted from higher highs to lower highs, with price breaking below recent swing low area around 554-555 and currently trading near 555.15.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Completed candle close below swing low to confirm bearish BOS follow-through.

tracked_patterns.name: Head and Shoulders
tracked_patterns.evidence: Three peaks visible: left shoulder around 560-561, head around 562-563, right shoulder around 560-561. Price currently testing neckline area near 556-557 at approximately 556.51.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Confirmed close below neckline; right shoulder formation not yet complete; breakdown candle not yet closed.

tracked_patterns.name: Break of Structure (BOS)
tracked_patterns.evidence: Prior bullish market structure broken after rejection from 562. Price declined below recent higher lows around 555-556, indicating bearish structure shift.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Further downside follow-through and candle close confirmation to fully validate bearish BOS.

tracked_patterns.name: Descending Triangle
tracked_patterns.evidence: Series of lower highs from 562.50 toward 560.50 and lower, with price consolidating near horizontal support around 555.00-556.00.
tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Clear breakdown below 555.00 support or rejection at descending resistance

tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Next candle close to confirm directional follow-through (bullish or bearish).

tracked_patterns.missing_conditions: Candle close confirmation below broken structure level.
